notes: «أبي رحمة الله» : the compiler's father, named by relation; the blessing is left out
«عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام» stands in the chain after «عن», so the Imam is a narrator link (owner ruling)
Sudayr's first-person narrative («دخلت عليه») sits inside the chain's last link; the Imam's words are the saying
